english.title: Failing to return drivers record book on leaving employment ( domestic )
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the employee-driver to whom a driver's record book had been issued by **(..SPECIFY EMPLOYER..), your employer, failed to return that book (including all unused weekly record sheets) to your employer on ceasing to be so employed
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 6(3) of the Drivers' Hours (Goods Vehicles) (Keeping of Records) Regulations 1987 and section 98(4) of the Transport Act 1968.

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, who had been employed by **(..SPECIFY EMPLOYER..) as a driver and who had been issued by that employer with a driver's record book, failed to return it, together with all unused weekly record sheets, to that employer on ceasing employment.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
